name: CI - MacOS/Linux/Windows via Pixi

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/28474#discussioncomment-3350256
  check_skip_flags:
    name: Check skip flags
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      head-commit-message: ${{ steps.get_head_commit_message.outputs.headCommitMsg }}
    steps:
      - name: Get repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Print head git commit message
        id: get_head_commit_message
        run: echo "headCommitMsg=$(git show -s --format=%s)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  visp-pixi:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} - Env ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ matrix.build_type }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: check_skip_flags
    if: >-
      ${{
        (!contains(needs.check_skip_flags.outputs.head-commit-message, '[SKIP-CI ALL]') &&
        !contains(needs.check_skip_flags.outputs.head-commit-message, '[SKIP-CI PIXI]')) ||
        contains(needs.check_skip_flags.outputs.head-commit-message, '[ENABLE-CI PIXI]')
      }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest, macos-15-intel, windows-latest]
        environment: [full-ci-python-oldest, full-ci-python-supported]
        build_type: [Release]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            environment: full-ci-clang-cl-python-oldest
            build_type: Release
          - os: windows-latest
            environment: full-ci-clang-cl-python-supported
            build_type: Release

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.9.2
        with:
          cache: true
          environments: ${{ matrix.environment }}

      - name: Clone visp-images
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        # https://remarkablemark.org/blog/2022/09/25/check-git-branch-exists-in-remote-repository/
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lagadic/visp-images ${HOME}/visp-images
          echo "VISP_INPUT_IMAGE_PATH=$HOME/visp-images" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo ${VISP_INPUT_IMAGE_PATH}

      - name: Build Visp [MacOS/Linux/Windows]
        shell: bash -el {0}
        env:
          VISP_BUILD_TYPE: ${{ matrix.build_type }}
        run: |
          pixi run -e ${{ matrix.environment }} configure
          pixi run -e ${{ matrix.environment }} build

      - name: Run tests [MacOS/Linux/Windows]
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          pixi run -e ${{ matrix.environment }} test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
